Filemite

## What this is
Filemite is a free web app with small, focused tools for images and PDFs.
Compress, convert, resize, remove-metadata and favicon image tools run on the server in memory and never store files; collage, GIF, passport photo, beautify, annotate, crop, rotate, redact, watermark and palette run in the browser.
PDF tools run entirely in the browser with MuPDF (WebAssembly); PDFs are never uploaded.

## Canonical site
https://filemite.com

## Image tools
- Compress: https://filemite.com/image/compress
- Convert format (HEIC to JPG, PNG, WebP): https://filemite.com/image/convert
- Resize: https://filemite.com/image/resize
- Smart crop: https://filemite.com/image/crop
- Rotate & flip: https://filemite.com/image/rotate
- Blur & redact: https://filemite.com/image/redact
- Add watermark: https://filemite.com/image/watermark
- Remove metadata (EXIF/GPS): https://filemite.com/image/scrub
- Color palette: https://filemite.com/image/palette
- Favicon generator: https://filemite.com/image/favicon
- Collage maker: https://filemite.com/image/collage
- GIF maker: https://filemite.com/image/gif
- Passport photo maker: https://filemite.com/image/passport
- Screenshot beautifier: https://filemite.com/image/beautify
- Annotate image (arrows, text, steps): https://filemite.com/image/annotate

## PDF tools
- Merge: https://filemite.com/pdf/merge
- Split: https://filemite.com/pdf/split
- Extract / remove pages: https://filemite.com/pdf/extract
- Rotate & reorder pages: https://filemite.com/pdf/organize
- Compress: https://filemite.com/pdf/compress
- Images to PDF: https://filemite.com/pdf/from-images
- PDF to images: https://filemite.com/pdf/to-images
- Sign: https://filemite.com/pdf/sign
- Fill & annotate: https://filemite.com/pdf/annotate
- Redact: https://filemite.com/pdf/redact

## Limits
- Images: 10 per batch, 4 MB each, 50 megapixels max, 2 processed at a time, 100 per hour per visitor.
- PDFs: up to 250 MB each, 20 per merge; processed on the visitor's device.
